They multiply when on death!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 9 ([[Cold Ambush]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Snow Golem''' was a large and tanky enemy that appeared on Wave 8 of [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had a high amount of health and slow speed. Upon death, it spawns three [[Snowman (Cold Ambush)|Snowmen]], which can easily overwhelm unprepared players. In [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, it summons [[Operation I.C.E Event]] [[Snowman|Snowmen]] normally. ==Appearance== The '''Snow Golem''' is a large hulking figure built from snow. Its rig has a waist and lower arms and legs. It has an orange carrot for a nose, black pebble eyes and a stick which resembles a unibrow. There are multiple sticks lodged into the backside of its torso. On the front of its torso there are two large black pebbles, which resemble buttons. There is another pebble button on the front of its waist. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Cold Ambush]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. **Multiple weaker towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Cowboy]], [[Militant]] or [[Golden Cowboy]] can also work. **Additionally, support towers such as [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost these towers, further increasing their effectiveness. *Towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Executioner]] and [[Mortar]] can be quite useful against this, as it spawns multiple enemies when killed. *Due to how many [[Snowman (Cold Ambush)|Snowmen]] are spawned upon the '''Snow Golem's''' death, it is recommended to defeat this enemy as far away from the tree as possible. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSnowGolem.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ViolentNightSnowGolemIconIG.png|'''Snow Golem''' on its icon. }} ==Trivia== *Weirdly, the dialogue for the '''Snow Golem''' appeared on Wave 9, despite its debut wave being Wave 8. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Snow Golem''' added. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **'''Snow Golem''' removed. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Snow Golem''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Snow Golem]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{ColdAmbush|[[Snowman (Cold Ambush)|Snowman]]|Wave 7|Snow Golem|Wave 8|[[Tough Cookie (Cold Ambush)|Tough Cookie]]|Wave 10}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Snow Golem}}
